name: Repair
body:
Design creation (generation); Level 0

CASTING

Casting Time 10 minutes

EFFECT

Range 10 ft.
Target one object of up to 1 lb./level
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless, object); Spell Resistance yes (harmless, object)

DESCRIPTION

This script repairs damaged objects, as a mending spell, except as noted here.

Overload: For every runic charge overloaded into this script, you treat your caster level as 2 higher for determining the size of the object you can repair, and it restores an additional 1 hit point.
